/*
  Übernimmt das originale Website-Icon.

  Alternativ lässt sich eine direkte Favicon-URL
  oben im HTML bei data-icon-url="" eintragen.
*/
(() => {
  const selectors = [
    'link[rel~="icon"][type="image/svg+xml"]',
    'link[rel~="icon"][sizes="any"]',
    'link[rel~="icon"][sizes="512x512"]',
    'link[rel~="icon"][sizes="192x192"]',
    'link[rel="apple-touch-icon"]',
    'link[rel~="icon"]'
  ];

  const siteIcon = selectors
    .map(selector => document.querySelector(selector))
    .find(Boolean);

  document
    .querySelectorAll('[data-collana-branches]')
    .forEach(panel => {
      const mark = panel.querySelector(
        '.collana-menu-branches__mark'
      );

      const source =
        panel.dataset.iconUrl.trim() ||
        (siteIcon && siteIcon.href);

      if (
        !mark ||
        !source ||
        mark.dataset.source === source
      ) {
        return;
      }

      mark.dataset.source = source;

      mark.addEventListener('load', () => {
        panel.classList.add('has-brand-icon');
      }, { once: true });

      mark.addEventListener('error', () => {
        panel.classList.remove('has-brand-icon');
      }, { once: true });

      mark.src = source;
    });
})();
</script>				</div>

/*
  Übernimmt das originale Website-Icon.

  Alternativ lässt sich eine direkte Favicon-URL
  oben im HTML bei data-icon-url="" eintragen.
*/
(() => {
  const selectors = [
    'link[rel~="icon"][type="image/svg+xml"]',
    'link[rel~="icon"][sizes="any"]',
    'link[rel~="icon"][sizes="512x512"]',
    'link[rel~="icon"][sizes="192x192"]',
    'link[rel="apple-touch-icon"]',
    'link[rel~="icon"]'
  ];

  const siteIcon = selectors
    .map(selector => document.querySelector(selector))
    .find(Boolean);

  document
    .querySelectorAll('[data-collana-branches]')
    .forEach(panel => {
      const mark = panel.querySelector(
        '.collana-menu-branches__mark'
      );

      const source =
        panel.dataset.iconUrl.trim() ||
        (siteIcon && siteIcon.href);

      if (
        !mark ||
        !source ||
        mark.dataset.source === source
      ) {
        return;
      }

      mark.dataset.source = source;

      mark.addEventListener('load', () => {
        panel.classList.add('has-brand-icon');
      }, { once: true });

      mark.addEventListener('error', () => {
        panel.classList.remove('has-brand-icon');
      }, { once: true });

      mark.src = source;
    });
})();

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  function isHomePage() {
    var path = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/';

    return path === '/' ||
      path === '/en' ||
      !!(
        document.body &&
        document.body.classList.contains('home')
      );
  }

  function isEditMode() {
    try {
      if (
        window.elementorFrontend &&
        typeof window.elementorFrontend.isEditMode === 'function' &&

      ) {
        return true;
      }

    ) {
      return true;
    }

    ) {

    }

      ) {

      }
    } catch (e) {}

  }

  function init() {
    // Startseite und Editor ausschließen.
    // Doppelte Initialisierung verhindern.
    if (
      isHomePage() ||
      isEditMode() ||
      window.__collanaTabHashInitialized
    ) {
      return;
    }

    window.__collanaTabHashInitialized = true;

    var openingFromHash = false;
    var pendingTimers = [];

    function cancelPending() {
      pendingTimers.forEach(function (timer) {
        window.clearTimeout(timer);
      });

      pendingTimers = [];
    }

      var id = String(hash || '').replace(/^#/, '');

      if (!id) return null;

      try {
        id = decodeURIComponent(id);
      } catch (e) {}

      // Verlinkung über die CSS-ID des Tab-Buttons.
      var target = document.getElementById(id);

      if (
        target &&
        target.classList.contains('e-n-tab-title')
      ) {
        return target;
      }

      // Alternativ: Verlinkung über die ID des Tab-Inhalts.
      var tabs = document.querySelectorAll(
        '.e-n-tab-title[aria-controls]'
      );

      for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) {

        ).split(/\s+/);

        }

      var requestedHash = window.location.hash;

        !requestedHash ||
        isHomePage() ||
        isEditMode()
      ) {
        return;

      // Sobald der gewünschte Tab aktiv ist, aufhören.

        pendingTimers.push(
          window.setTimeout(function () {
            if (
              isHomePage() ||
              isEditMode() ||
              window.location.hash !== requestedHash

              cancelPending();
              return;
            }

            var tab = findTab(requestedHash);

            if (!tab) return;

              return;

            try {
              tab.click();
            } finally {
              openingFromHash = false;
            }

              cancelPending();
            }

        openingFromHash ||
        isHomePage() ||
        isEditMode()
      ) {
        return;
      }

      var target = event.target;

      var tab = (
        target &&
        typeof target.closest === 'function'
      )
        ? target.closest('.e-n-tab-title')
        : null;

      if (!tab) return;

        window.history.state,
        '',
        window.location.pathname +
          window.location.search +
          hash
      );
    }, true);

    window.addEventListener(
      'hashchange',
      activateCurrentHash
    );

    window.addEventListener(
      'load',
      activateCurrentHash,
      { once: true }
    );

    // Kein globaler Hook, der für jedes Element erneut läuft.

        activateCurrentHash
